name: netdiag-mcp
description: netdiag-mcp server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: netdiag-mcp
plugins.description: On-demand network diagnostics for Claude Code: DNS lookups and DNSSEC validation, ping and traceroute, TCP port and HTTP checks, TLS certificate inspection, and whois/ASN lookups. Read-only by construction — it observes the network and never changes anything. Needs the dig, ping, mtr and whois binaries on the machine; the TCP, HTTP and TLS checks are pure Python and work without them.
